literal_meaning: একই ঘাটের জল (water from the same ghat or riverbank steps)
figurative_meaning_en: Of the same quality or characteristics; from the same lineage or kin
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা একঘাটের জল, সবাই একই ধরনের কাজ করে।
ভাই-বোনেরা একঘাটের জল, তাই তাদের মধ্যে এত মিল।
example_sentences_in_english: They are like water from the same ghat, all doing similar kinds of work.
The siblings are from the same ghat's water, so there's so much similarity between them.
note: This idiom draws from rural Bengali imagery of shared water sources symbolizing common origins.
